difficulty.rationale_zh: 標準雙人職場對話，涵蓋問題原因、同義改寫細節與下一步行動，語速與句構自然清晰。

audio_script.text_en: Hi, Clara. I'm calling from Apex Printing about the five hundred product brochures you ordered for the Milan Trade Fair next week.
Hello, Devon. Is everything on track for Thursday delivery? Our sales team flies out on Friday evening.

Well, our supplier just notified us that the glossy cardstock you requested is on backorder until next month. However, we do have a heavy matte recycled paper in stock that has a very similar thickness.
Hmm, matte paper might actually look quite sophisticated with our new brand colors. Would using that material change the total cost?
It's normally a bit pricier, but since the shortage is on our end, we'll honor your original quote and still deliver by Thursday afternoon.
That sounds fair. Please go ahead with the matte stock, and send me a revised order confirmation for our accounting files.
Why is the man calling the woman?
What does the man offer to do to resolve the issue?
What does the woman ask the man to send her?

assets.source_note_zh: 待合成 Part 3 雙人對話與旁白音檔（口音規劃：美式男聲 + 英式女聲 + 美式旁白）。

items.prompt_en: Why is the man calling the woman?

choices.text_en: To verify the spelling of a company name
To report a shortage of a requested material
To request an extension on an invoice payment
To confirm flight reservations for a trade fair

evidence.quote_en: our supplier just notified us that the glossy cardstock you requested is on backorder until next month.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 男子說明客戶指定的亮面厚卡紙缺貨（on backorder），對應選項 B 通報所要求材料的短缺問題。

items.explanation_zh: 男子在第三段話明確指出：「供應商剛通知我們，您指定的亮面厚卡紙缺貨待補（on backorder）要到下個月才會到」，因此致電目的是 **(B) 通報所指定印刷材質缺貨**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 對話中未討論公司名稱拼字校對。
對話未涉及逾期帳單或延後付款請求。
是女方提到業務團隊週五搭機，男方為印刷廠人員，並非確認機票訂位。

vocabulary.example_en: The replacement parts are currently on backorder from the manufacturer.

items.prompt_en: What does the man offer to do to resolve the issue?

choices.text_en: Deliver the brochures directly to the airport
Print a smaller quantity of brochures
Provide a higher-priced paper at no extra charge
Outsource the printing job to another facility

evidence.quote_en: It's normally a bit pricier, but since the shortage is on our end, we'll honor your original quote
evidence.reasoning_zh: 男子表示霧面再生紙平常較貴（pricier），但願意維持原報價（honor your original quote），即不額外收費提供較高價紙張。

items.explanation_zh: 男子提議改用庫存的霧面厚再生紙，並在女方詢問價格時表示：「這種紙平常比較貴（a bit pricier），但因為缺貨是我們的問題，我們將維持您的原報價（honor your original quote）」，以 `at no extra charge` 改寫 `honor your original quote`，故選 **(C)**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 對話僅說週四下午前送達，未提直送機場。
五百份的印製數量並未減少。
印刷廠本身就有霧面再生紙庫存，並未委外給其他工廠。

vocabulary.example_en: We will honor the original quote for thirty days.

items.prompt_en: What does the woman ask the man to send her?

choices.text_en: A physical paper sample
An updated order confirmation
A catalog of display stands
A shipping tracking number

evidence.quote_en: send me a revised order confirmation for our accounting files.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 女子在結尾要求寄給她一份修改後的訂單確認書（revised order confirmation），以 updated 改寫 revised。

items.explanation_zh: 女子在對話最後一句說：「請照這方案改用霧面紙，並寄給我一份修改後的訂單確認書（a revised order confirmation）供會計歸檔」，選項 **(B) An updated order confirmation** 以 `updated` 同義替換 `revised`。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 因時間緊迫，女子直接同意使用霧面紙，未要求先寄實體紙樣。
對話未提及展示架型錄。
宣傳冊尚未印製出貨，女子要求的是訂單確認單而非貨運追蹤碼。

vocabulary.example_en: Business cards are printed on heavyweight cardstock.

That's no problem at all. We can place four more armchairs on the main platform right away. Will they also need extra microphones?
Yes, please. Right now there's only one podium microphone, so having two handheld wireless ones to pass around would be ideal.
I'll contact our audiovisual technician immediately so he can bring those up and test the sound levels before your guests arrive at six.

A corporate awards banquet
A press conference for a new hotel
A floral arrangement workshop

evidence.quote_en: setting up the twenty round tables for your company's awards dinner tonight.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一段明確提到今晚舉辦的是貴公司的頒獎晚宴（your company's awards dinner），對應 corporate awards banquet。

items.explanation_zh: 飯店活動協調員在開場白中提到：「我們的宴會人員已經為貴公司今晚的頒獎晚宴（your company's awards dinner tonight）擺設好二十張圓桌」，選項 **(B) A corporate awards banquet** 以 `corporate` 改寫 `company's`、以 `banquet` 改寫 `dinner`。

choices.text_en: The projection screen is partially blocked.
The keynote speaker canceled at the last minute.
More participants will take part in a panel discussion.
A musical group needs room for its instruments.

evidence.quote_en: four additional regional managers will be joining our executive panel on stage after dessert.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 男子表示剛得知有另外四位區域經理將上台加入高階主管座談（joining our executive panel），故需在台上增加座椅與麥克風。

items.explanation_zh: 男子在第二段說明：「我剛得知甜點過後，會有另外四位區域經理上台加入我們的高階主管座談（joining our executive panel on stage）」，因此要求在舞台增加四張扶手椅與兩支無線麥克風，故選 **(C)**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 對話完全未提及投影幕被遮擋。
是臨時增加四位座談與談人，而非講者取消出席。
對話未提及樂團或樂器空間。

vocabulary.example_en: An executive panel answered questions from shareholders.

items.prompt_en: What will the audiovisual technician do before 6:00 P.M.?

choices.text_en: Replace the spotlight bulbs
Set up and test wireless microphones
Record a video of the speeches
Install a backup power generator

evidence.quote_en: having two handheld wireless ones to pass around would be ideal.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 男子要求兩支手持無線麥克風。

evidence.quote_en: I'll contact our audiovisual technician immediately so he can bring those up and test the sound levels before your guests arrive at six.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 女子表示會立即請視聽技術人員在六點賓客抵達前將那兩支無線麥克風送來並測試音量。

items.explanation_zh: 結合第四、五段，男子提出需要兩支手持無線麥克風（two handheld wireless ones），女子隨即表示會立刻聯繫視聽技術員，「在六點賓客抵達前把麥克風送來並測試音量（bring those up and test the sound levels）」，故選 **(B)**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 未提及更換聚光燈燈泡。
未要求錄製演講影片。
未提及安裝備用發電機。

vocabulary.example_en: The audiovisual technician adjusted the volume on the mixer.

audio_script.text_en: Thanks for meeting, everyone. As you know, Greenleaf Supermarkets agreed to carry our herbal iced tea line starting in July, provided we switch from glass bottles to lightweight aluminum cans.

My design team has already adapted the label artwork to fit twelve-ounce cans. However, printing the metallic gold leaf border directly onto aluminum will increase unit production costs by fifteen percent.
Our profit margin on wholesale supermarket orders is already very tight.
I figured that might be an issue. If we replace the metallic foil with a standard matte yellow ink, we can keep the vibrant look without paying a premium.
Let's go with the standard yellow ink, then. Liam, can you have physical mock-ups ready for the supermarket buyers by Wednesday?
Yes, I'll print three sample cans this afternoon and send them to your office.
What condition did Greenleaf Supermarkets set for carrying the beverage line?
Why does the second woman say, 'Our profit margin on wholesale supermarket orders is already very tight'?
What will Liam do this afternoon?

assets.source_note_zh: 待合成 Part 3 三人對話音檔（口音規劃：美式女聲 + 澳洲男聲 + 英式女聲 + 美式旁白）。

items.prompt_en: What condition did Greenleaf Supermarkets set for carrying the beverage line?

choices.text_en: The beverages must be certified organic by June.
The drink containers must be changed to aluminum cans.
The company must provide free promotional display racks.
The wholesale price must be reduced by fifteen percent.

evidence.quote_en: Greenleaf Supermarkets agreed to carry our herbal iced tea line starting in July, provided we switch from glass bottles to lightweight aluminum cans.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 條件連接詞 provided 後方說明超市上架的前提是「將玻璃瓶改為輕量鋁罐」。

items.explanation_zh: 第一段話中，產品經理說明 Greenleaf 超市同意自七月起上架花草冰茶系列，「條件是我們必須將玻璃瓶改為輕量鋁罐（provided we switch from glass bottles to lightweight aluminum cans）」，故選 **(B)**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 對話提及的是七月上架花草冰茶，未要求六月前取得有機認證。
未提及免費提供促銷展示架。
百分之十五是印製金屬金箔邊框會增加的生產成本，而非超市要求降價百分之十五。

vocabulary.example_en: We can meet the deadline provided that the materials arrive today.

items.prompt_en: Why does the second woman say, "Our profit margin on wholesale supermarket orders is already very tight"?

choices.text_en: To object to an option that would raise manufacturing costs
To explain why a supermarket contract was rejected
To request a bonus for the sales department
To suggest increasing the retail price of glass bottles

evidence.quote_en: printing the metallic gold leaf border directly onto aluminum will increase unit production costs by fifteen percent.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 設計師剛指出在鋁罐上印製金屬金箔邊框會使單位生產成本增加 15%。

evidence.quote_en: Our profit margin on wholesale supermarket orders is already very tight.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 採購主管回應批發訂單利潤率已經很微薄，意在委婉反對會增加 15% 生產成本的金箔印刷方案。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考說話者意圖（Speaker Intent）。前一句設計師 Liam 指出直接在鋁罐印上金箔邊框會讓單位生產成本增加 15%，採購主管隨即說「我們超市批發訂單的利潤空間已經非常緊繃了」，其言外之意是無法再吸收 15% 的額外成本，亦即 **(A) 反對會提高製造費用的方案**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 超市合約已經談妥將於七月上架，並未被拒絕。
利潤微薄與替業務部門爭取獎金無關。
超市要求改用鋁罐，並非建議調漲玻璃瓶零售價。

vocabulary.example_en: Higher shipping fees reduced our net profit margin.

items.prompt_en: What will Liam do this afternoon?

choices.text_en: Visit a bottling plant
Produce sample cans
Negotiate with an ink supplier
Update a website banner

evidence.quote_en: Yes, I'll print three sample cans this afternoon and send them to your office.
evidence.reasoning_zh: Liam 表示今天下午會印製三個樣品罐（print three sample cans）並送到對方辦公室。

items.explanation_zh: 在第五、六段中，產品經理詢問 Liam 能否在週三前準備好實體模型（physical mock-ups），Liam 回答：「可以，我今天下午就會印製三個樣品罐（print three sample cans）並送到您的辦公室」，故選 **(B) 製作樣品罐**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 未提及前往裝瓶廠視察。
直接改用標準霧面黃色油墨即可，無須與油墨供應商談判。
討論的是實體鋁罐包裝而非網站橫幅。

vocabulary.example_en: The designer presented a full-scale mock-up of the cereal box.

audio_script.text_en: Good morning, Arthur. Now that our clinic has switched to the new patient scheduling software, how is the front desk staff adjusting to it?

Oh, that would save us a lot of time during morning check-in!
I'll print laminated copies for each workstation before lunch, and we can walk through the procedure during tomorrow's fifteen-minute staff huddle.

evidence.quote_en: Priority Express | 2 Business Days | $64
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對照表格中 Delivery Speed 為 2 Business Days 的 Priority Express 方案，基本運費為 $64。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考音訊與圖表整合（Graphic Integration）。對話中女子指出：「今天是週二，我們不需要付隔日達的費用，只要在兩個工作天內（in two business days）送達即可」，並在最後確認「我會在網站選擇兩日達方案（the two-day shipping tier）」。對照表格中 `Delivery Speed` 為 `2 Business Days` 的 `Priority Express`，對應的基本運費為 **(C) $64**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: $28 為五個工作天的 Economy Ground，無法在週五會議前送達。
$46 為三個工作天的 Standard Air，女子明確要求週四下午前（兩個工作天）送達。
$95 為隔日達 Overnight Courier，女子明確排除（don't need to pay for next-day delivery）。

vocabulary.example_en: Each service tier includes online package tracking.

items.prompt_en: What does the woman ask the man to do by 3:00 P.M.?

choices.text_en: Measure the dimensions of the crate
Take the package to the front desk
Email photographs of the bridge model
Sign a customs declaration form

evidence.quote_en: If you bring the crate to the reception desk by three o'clock, the afternoon driver can scan it.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 女子請男子在三點前把木箱拿到接待櫃檯（bring the crate to the reception desk），以 Take the package to the front desk 同義改寫。

items.explanation_zh: 女子在最後一段說：「如果您在三點前把木箱拿到接待櫃檯（bring the crate to the reception desk by three o'clock），下午來的司機就能掃描收件」，選項 **(B) Take the package to the front desk** 為精準同義改寫。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 木箱已經打包並秤重完畢（八公斤），未要求測量尺寸。
未提及寄送模型照片。
此為國內快遞（Domestic Shipping 至波士頓），無須填寫海關申報單。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 加有緩衝襯墊的木箱／貨箱
vocabulary.example_en: The sculpture was shipped in a custom padded crate.

difficulty.rationale_zh: 高難度圖表整合與意圖題：需同時滿足人數上限（42人）與雙螢幕投影設備兩項條件，才能從四間會議室表格中篩選出唯一正解。

documents.title_en: Westlake Training Center — Available Rooms (Friday Morning)

audio_script.text_en: Hi, Oliver. I'm scheduled to lead the financial modeling workshop in Cedar Hall this Friday morning, but forty-two people have signed up so far.
Oh, Cedar Hall only holds thirty-five. Let's look at the room availability chart for Friday morning and move your session to a larger space.
Keep in mind that attendees need to compare live spreadsheet formulas on one screen while viewing the case study slides on another.
Right, so Maple Suite won't work even though it's big enough. I'll reserve the other large room that has the twin screen setup you need.
Wonderful. I'll send an automated calendar update to all registered participants this afternoon so nobody goes to the wrong room on Friday.
Why does the woman need to change rooms?
Why does the woman mention comparing spreadsheet formulas and case study slides?
Look at the graphic. Which room will the man reserve for the workshop?

assets.source_note_zh: 待合成 Part 3 圖表與意圖整合高難度對話音檔（口音規劃：澳洲女聲 + 英式男聲 + 美式旁白）。

items.prompt_en: Why does the woman need to change rooms?

choices.text_en: The air-conditioning in Cedar Hall is broken.
Registration has exceeded the current room's seating limit.
Another department booked the room for an all-day seminar.
The workshop has been moved to a different day.

evidence.quote_en: I'm scheduled to lead the financial modeling workshop in Cedar Hall this Friday morning, but forty-two people have signed up so far.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 女子原訂在容量 35 人的 Cedar Hall 上課，但目前已有 42 人報名（exceeded the current room's seating limit）。

items.explanation_zh: 女子在第一段指出原訂於 Cedar Hall 舉辦財務建模工作坊，但目前已有 42 人報名，而男子指出 Cedar Hall 僅能容納 35 人，即 **(B) 報名人數已超出目前教室的座位上限**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 對話未提及空調故障。
並非與其他部門撞期，而是報名人數超額。
課程仍在週五上午舉行，並未改期。

vocabulary.example_en: Over forty employees signed up for the training session.

items.prompt_en: Why does the woman mention comparing spreadsheet formulas and case study slides?

choices.text_en: To request extra printed handouts for attendees
To explain a technical requirement for the room's equipment
To ask the man to proofread her presentation
To suggest shortening the length of the workshop

evidence.quote_en: Keep in mind that attendees need to compare live spreadsheet formulas on one screen while viewing the case study slides on another.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 女子提醒學員需要在一個螢幕看試算表公式、同時在另一個螢幕看個案投影片，藉此說明新教室必須具備雙投影螢幕設備。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考說話者意圖。當男子準備挑選更大的教室時，女子提醒：「請留意，學員需要在一個螢幕上比對即時試算表公式，同時在另一個螢幕上看個案研究投影片」，目的是 **(B) 說明對教室硬體設備（雙螢幕）的技術需求**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 女子強調的是雙螢幕顯示，而非要求加印紙本講義。
未要求男子校對簡報內容。
未提議縮短工作坊時長。

vocabulary.example_en: The instructor presented a case study on corporate mergers.

items.prompt_en: Look at the graphic. Which room will the man reserve for the workshop?

choices.text_en: Birch Room
Cedar Hall
Maple Suite
Redwood Room

evidence.quote_en: Right, so Maple Suite won't work even though it's big enough. I'll reserve the other large room that has the twin screen setup you need.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 男子排除 Maple Suite（僅單一投影機），選擇另一間能容納 42 人以上且具備雙投影螢幕的大教室。

evidence.quote_en: Redwood Room | 55 | Dual Projection Screens
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對照表格，容量大於 42 人（Max Capacity 55）且具備 Dual Projection Screens 的唯一教室為 Redwood Room。

items.explanation_zh: 本題考多條件圖表整合。工作坊有 42 人報名，故容量 25 人的 `Birch Room` 與 35 人的 `Cedar Hall` 皆不敷使用；而容量 50 人的 `Maple Suite` 僅有單一標準投影機（`Single Standard Projector`），已被男子排除。唯一同時滿足容量（55人）與雙投影螢幕（`Dual Projection Screens`）的教室為 **(D) Redwood Room**。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Birch Room 僅能容納 25 人且只有互動白板。
Cedar Hall 為原本預訂的教室，容量 35 人裝不下 42 位學員。
Maple Suite 雖可容納 50 人，但僅配備單一投影機，不符雙螢幕需求。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 最大容納人數；容量上限
vocabulary.example_en: The conference room has a max capacity of fifty seated guests.
